title: gamma5 in FDH
claim: Studies the scheme dependence of gamma5 treatments, focusing on FDH: the four-dimensional formulation of FDH (FDF) handles gamma5 well at one loop; two-loop pseudoscalar quark and gluon form factors computed in FDH, including the required operator renormalization.

checked_partially: Two-loop pseudoscalar form factors in FDH.
